caption: The drawing depicts a white or light-colored statue of a woman standing on a rectangular base against a solid blue background. The woman has long, wavy hair and is dressed in draped, classical-style clothing that exposes her right shoulder and breast. Her left arm is bent at the elbow with the hand pointing upward, while her right arm rests on an anchor, which is positioned diagonally and touches the base near her feet. Her left leg is bent at the knee, with the foot resting forward, and she is barefoot. The overall composition centers the statue in the frame, and the background is featureless and plain.
title: Architectural Carving "Hope"
